what: Every acceptance register in this repository, with the consumers that read it. tools/gates/acceptance-fields.mjs discovers candidates dynamically -- any JSON file git tracks under tools/ or scripts/, or at the repository root, whose top level holds a non-empty array of entry objects -- and exits 1 on any candidate this file does not classify. So a register cannot appear in silence, and a register's fields cannot grow a reason nothing reads.
why_the_consumers_are_listed_rather_than: A field counts as read when a consumer dereferences it, so the answer depends on which files are consumers. Searching the whole tree for `.why` would find every unrelated object with a `why` on it and grade every register clean. Naming the consumers makes that choice reviewable, and CONSUMER_MISSING fires if one of these paths leaves the tree, because then every field of that register would read as unread for a reason about this file rather than about the register.
declares: A register may declare a field documentation-only by listing it under `_documentation_only` as `{ "field": "the reason" }`. tools/secret-scan.baseline.json already does this in prose -- `where` is documentation only, because the scanner reports the first path a blob is reachable at and that is a function of history -- which is the form this gate asks every register to put in a key its tool can read. The declaration is the OWNING seat's to write, which is why nothing here adds one on another seat's behalf.

out_of_scope.why: The design reviews hold dozens of measurement dumps -- hit areas, focus rows, contrast samples -- which are records of what was observed and nobody's accepted risk. Including them would turn this manifest into a list of things to ignore, which is the defect it exists to prevent, one level up.

The only register here whose reason is EXECUTED rather than read: each entry declares a `stand_in`, and the runner materialises the fixture, re-runs that one test and absorbs the failure only if it goes green. It is Python, and tools/secret-print-exemptions.py is the tool that grades it. Named rather than omitted, because it is the standard the registers above are being measured against.

_documentation_only.note: Prose for a human reading this manifest. It carries no claim a tool could check: a register's consumers are the checkable part and they are in `consumers`. Declared here rather than baselined, because declaring it is the correct end state and this is the one register whose owner is the seat writing the gate.
